finding: The v12 rule excluding every halo at or above 5e12 Msun/h within 8 Mpc/h of either the observer or LG midpoint is not a valid hard Local-Group isolation criterion. It is substantially stronger than the standard pair-isolation criterion and can exclude the observed Local Volume itself.

project_evidence.interpretation: The v12 zero yield is caused by stable parent-environment groups, not by the LG peak conditioning. Erasing these groups with high-k anti-peaks would alter the CF4 parent to satisfy an unsupported gate.

observational_basis.standard_LG_pair_isolation: No third halo at least as massive as the smaller pair member within 2.5 Mpc/h of the pair centre.
observational_basis.nearby_group_counterexample: The observed Centaurus A group is approximately 3.8 Mpc from the Local Group and published group-mass estimates are approximately 9e12 to 1.4e13 Msun. For h=0.746, 9e12 Msun is approximately 6.7e12 Msun/h, already above the v12 threshold.

corrected_policy.definitive_third_halo_rule: No third halo more massive than the smaller pair member within 2.5 Mpc/h of the pair midpoint.

selection.rule: Minimum preregistered LG ranking score among the 17 v11 pair-screen passes; index breaks exact ties.
selection.next: Exactly reproduce seed 40274, then run the unchanged GRAFIC to RAMSES to GalaxyFinder/HOP validation chain. Sub-grid pair separation and M33 remain zoom-resolution gates.
